records.script:
# Final Inspection, Before Save: the lot (packing lists), the AQL sample and accept/reject numbers, the defects found, the re-inspection chain
# and the result (Accepted needs every check passed and the defects within the plan; a concession needs the buyer's reference).
def run(doc):
    # shared helpers: the AQL row for a lot size, and the seeded carton draw (production/packing.draw_cartons, without `random`)
    def aql_row(plan, lot_size):
        """The plan row whose lot range holds `lot_size`, or None."""
        for r in frappe.get_all("AQL Plan Row", {"parent": plan}, ["lot_from", "lot_to", "code_letter", "sample_size", "critical_ac", "critical_re", "major_ac", "major_re", "minor_ac", "minor_re", "confirmed"], order_by="lot_from"):
            if frappe.utils.cint(r.lot_from) <= lot_size and lot_size <= frappe.utils.cint(r.lot_to):
                return r
        return None


    def next_random(state):
        """One step of a linear congruential generator (31 bits). The same seed always gives the same draw."""
        return (state * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648


    def draw_cartons(cartons, how_many, seed):
        """Pick `how_many` of `cartons` = [[packing_list, carton_no, is_tail]] without repeats, the same draw for the same seed. A tail carton is
        always included when the lot has one, because mixed cartons are where packing errors hide."""
        pool = sorted(cartons)
        how_many = min(int(how_many), len(pool))
        state = int(seed) % 2147483648
        bag = list(pool)
        picked = []
        while len(picked) < how_many:
            state = next_random(state)
            picked.append(bag.pop((state // 65536) % len(bag)))
        tails = [c for c in pool if c[2]]
        if tails and how_many:
            has_tail = False
            for c in picked:
                if c[2]:
                    has_tail = True
            if not has_tail:
                state = next_random(state)
                picked[-1] = tails[(state // 65536) % len(tails)]
        return sorted(picked)
    cint = frappe.utils.cint
    flt = frappe.utils.flt
    FINAL_TYPES = ("Final", "Re-inspection", "2nd Re-inspection")
    CHECKS = ("fpt", "gpt", "azo", "wash_care_ok", "fibre_ok", "sealer_style", "sealer_material", "sealer_colour", "sealer_construction",
              "metal_detection_ok", "measurement_ok", "drop_test_ok", "barcode_ok", "packing_ok")
    mine = (frappe.get_all("Role", pluck="name") if frappe.session.user == "Administrator" else frappe.get_all("Has Role", {"parent": frappe.session.user, "parenttype": "User"}, pluck="role"))

    def setting(field, default):
        v = frappe.db.get_single_value("Apparel Settings", field)
        if v is None or v == "":
            return default
        return v

    doc.inspection_type = doc.inspection_type or "Final"
    card = frappe.db.get_value("Production Card", doc.production_card, ["sales_order", "sales_contract", "customer", "style_item", "status", "docstatus"], as_dict=True)
    if not card or card.docstatus != 1 or card.status in ("Superseded", "Cancelled", "Closed"):
        frappe.throw("Production card %s must be issued and open." % doc.production_card)
    doc.sales_contract = card.sales_contract
    doc.sales_order = card.sales_order
    doc.customer = card.customer
    doc.style_item = card.style_item

    # ---- the lot
    if not doc.lots:
        frappe.throw("Add the packing lists in the lot.")
    seen = []
    pieces = 0
    cartons = 0
    for l in doc.lots:
        pl = frappe.db.get_value("Packing List", l.packing_list, ["docstatus", "production_card", "total_pieces", "total_cartons"], as_dict=True)
        if not pl or pl.docstatus != 1:
            frappe.throw("Packing list %s must be submitted." % l.packing_list)
        if pl.production_card != doc.production_card:
            frappe.throw("Packing list %s belongs to another production card." % l.packing_list)
        if l.packing_list in seen:
            frappe.throw("Packing list %s is in the lot twice." % l.packing_list)
        seen.append(l.packing_list)
        l.pieces = pl.total_pieces
        l.cartons = pl.total_cartons
        pieces = pieces + cint(pl.total_pieces)
        cartons = cartons + cint(pl.total_cartons)
    doc.offered_qty = pieces
    doc.total_cartons = cartons
    doc.po_qty = sum([cint(r.order_qty) for r in frappe.get_all("Production Card Line", {"parent": doc.production_card}, ["order_qty"])])
    doc.packed_pct = round((float(pieces) / float(doc.po_qty) * 100.0) if doc.po_qty else 0, 2)
    if doc.inspection_type in FINAL_TYPES and doc.docstatus == 0:
        blocked_below = flt(setting("final_block_packed_pct", 50))
        warn_below = flt(setting("final_min_packed_pct", 80))
        if doc.packed_pct < blocked_below:
            frappe.throw("Only %s %% of the order is packed. A final inspection needs at least %s %%; use Pre-Final for an earlier look." % (doc.packed_pct, blocked_below))
        if doc.packed_pct < warn_below:
            frappe.msgprint("Only %s %% of the order is packed (%s %% is expected for a final inspection)." % (doc.packed_pct, warn_below), indicator="orange")

    # ---- the AQL sample
    doc.aql_plan = doc.aql_plan or setting("final_inspection_plan", None)
    if not doc.aql_plan:
        frappe.throw("Choose the AQL Plan, or set one in Apparel Settings.")
    doc.inspection_level = frappe.db.get_value("AQL Plan", doc.aql_plan, "inspection_level")
    row = aql_row(doc.aql_plan, cint(doc.offered_qty))
    if not row or not cint(row.confirmed):
        frappe.throw("The AQL plan has no confirmed row for a lot of %s pieces. QA must fill in and confirm that row from ISO 2859-1 Table 2-A first." % doc.offered_qty)
    doc.sample_size = cint(row.sample_size)
    doc.critical_ac = cint(row.critical_ac)
    doc.critical_re = cint(row.critical_re) or 1
    doc.major_ac = cint(row.major_ac)
    doc.major_re = cint(row.major_re)
    doc.minor_ac = cint(row.minor_ac)
    doc.minor_re = cint(row.minor_re)
    if setting("carton_pick_rule", "Square Root") == "Fixed Pct":
        doc.inspected_cartons = max(1, int(frappe.utils.ceil(cint(doc.total_cartons) * 10 / 100.0))) if cint(doc.total_cartons) > 0 else 0
    else:
        doc.inspected_cartons = int(frappe.utils.ceil(cint(doc.total_cartons) ** 0.5)) if cint(doc.total_cartons) > 0 else 0
    if doc.sample_size > cint(doc.offered_qty):
        doc.sample_size = cint(doc.offered_qty)

    # ---- the defects found against the plan
    tot = {"Critical": 0, "Major": 0, "Minor": 0}
    for d in doc.defects:
        d.qty = cint(d.qty)
        if d.qty <= 0:
            frappe.throw("Defect %s: enter a quantity above zero." % d.defect_code)
        sev = frappe.db.get_value("Apparel Defect Code", d.defect_code, "severity") or "Minor"
        d.severity = sev
        tot[sev] = tot.get(sev, 0) + d.qty
    doc.critical_found = tot["Critical"]
    doc.major_found = tot["Major"]
    doc.minor_found = tot["Minor"]
    if doc.critical_found >= doc.critical_re or doc.major_found >= doc.major_re or doc.minor_found >= doc.minor_re:
        doc.computed_result = "Rejected"
    else:
        doc.computed_result = "Accepted"

    # ---- a re-inspection follows a rejected or on-hold inspection of the same lot; too many needs a manager
    if doc.inspection_type in ("Re-inspection", "2nd Re-inspection") and not doc.previous_inspection:
        frappe.throw("Name the inspection this one follows.")
    n = 0
    prev = doc.previous_inspection
    chain = []
    while prev and prev not in chain:
        chain.append(prev)
        n = n + 1
        prev = frappe.db.get_value("Final Inspection", prev, "previous_inspection")
    limit = cint(setting("reinspection_limit", 2))
    if n >= limit and "Apparel Production Manager" not in mine and "System Manager" not in mine:
        frappe.throw("This lot has already been inspected %s times. A Production Manager must approve another." % n)

    # ---- the result
    if doc.result:
        if doc.result == "Accepted":
            if doc.computed_result == "Rejected":
                frappe.throw("The defects found fail the AQL plan (%s critical, %s major, %s minor). Choose Rejected, On Hold, or Accepted with Concession." % (doc.critical_found, doc.major_found, doc.minor_found))
            failed = [doc.meta.get_label(c) for c in CHECKS if doc.get(c) == "No"]
            if failed:
                frappe.throw("These checks failed: %s. They cannot be Accepted without a concession." % ", ".join(failed))
        if doc.result == "Accepted with Concession":
            if not (doc.concession_ref or "").strip() or not (doc.approved_by or "").strip():
                frappe.throw("A concession needs the buyer's approval reference and who approved it.")


run(doc)

# API arinox_sales_contract_make_sales_order: Sales Contract -> Sales Order (unsaved, returned as a document for the form to open):
# one row per size row, with the variant of the style for that colour and size (created when missing), the price of its contract line,
# and the colour, size, PO, dates and tolerance the production card and the shipping gates read.
def main():
    # shared helpers from materials/items.py (+ ensure_attribute_values from tech_pack.py): a template per fabric quality with the Colour attribute, a variant per colour,
    # and a plain stock item per trim code. Needs lib_mat.py (YARD_M).
    def ensure_attribute_values(attribute, values):
        if not frappe.db.exists("Item Attribute", attribute):
            frappe.get_doc({"doctype": "Item Attribute", "attribute_name": attribute, "item_attribute_values": []}).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        adoc = frappe.get_doc("Item Attribute", attribute)
        existing = [v.attribute_value.strip().upper() for v in adoc.item_attribute_values]
        abbrs = [v.abbr.upper() for v in adoc.item_attribute_values]
        added = False
        for value in values:
            value = (value or "").strip()
            if not value or value.upper() in existing:
                continue
            abbr = "".join([ch for ch in value.upper() if ch.isalnum()])[:10] or value[:10]
            base = abbr
            n = 1
            while abbr in abbrs:
                n = n + 1
                abbr = "%s%s" % (base[:8], n)
            adoc.append("item_attribute_values", {"attribute_value": value, "abbr": abbr})
            existing.append(value.upper())
            abbrs.append(abbr)
            added = True
        if added:
            adoc.flags.ignore_permissions = True
            adoc.save()


    def canonical_attribute_value(attribute, value):
        """The attribute's own spelling of `value`, adding the value when it is new. ERPNext compares the exact text when it makes a variant, so 'BLACK' is
        refused where the attribute says 'Black'."""
        ensure_attribute_values(attribute, [value])
        want = (value or "").strip().upper()
        for v in frappe.get_all("Item Attribute Value", filters={"parent": attribute, "parenttype": "Item Attribute"}, pluck="attribute_value"):
            if (v or "").strip().upper() == want:
                return v
        return (value or "").strip()


    def ensure_uom(name):
        if not frappe.db.exists("UOM", name):
            frappe.get_doc({"doctype": "UOM", "uom_name": name}).insert(ignore_permissions=True)


    def material_item_group():
        for g in ("Raw Material", "Raw Materials"):
            if frappe.db.exists("Item Group", g):
                return g
        return frappe.db.get_single_value("Apparel Settings", "style_item_group") or frappe.db.get_value("Item Group", {"is_group": 0}, "name")


    def add_uom_rows(item_doc, gsm, width_cm):
        """Yard always (1 yd = 0.9144 m); Kg when GSM and width are known (1 kg = 1000 / (gsm x width_m) m)."""
        have = [u.uom for u in item_doc.get("uoms") or []]
        if "Yard" not in have:
            ensure_uom("Yard")
            item_doc.append("uoms", {"uom": "Yard", "conversion_factor": YARD_M})
        if frappe.utils.flt(gsm) and frappe.utils.flt(width_cm) and "Kg" not in have:
            ensure_uom("Kg")
            item_doc.append("uoms", {"uom": "Kg", "conversion_factor": round(1000 / (frappe.utils.flt(gsm) * frappe.utils.flt(width_cm) / 100), 6)})


    def ensure_fabric_item(quality_code, colour, description, gsm, width_cm):
        """Template `quality_code` (stock UOM Meter, batch tracked, Colour attribute) and its colour variant; returns the variant item code. Safe to call again."""
        quality_code = (quality_code or "").strip()
        if not quality_code:
            frappe.throw("Enter the fabric quality code.")
        attr = frappe.db.get_single_value("Apparel Settings", "colour_attribute") or "Colour"
        colour = canonical_attribute_value(attr, colour)
        ensure_uom("Meter")
        if not frappe.db.exists("Item", quality_code):
            tpl = frappe.get_doc({"doctype": "Item", "item_code": quality_code, "item_name": quality_code, "item_group": material_item_group(), "stock_uom": "Meter",
                                  "is_stock_item": 1, "is_purchase_item": 1, "is_sales_item": 0, "has_batch_no": 1, "has_variants": 1, "variant_based_on": "Item Attribute",
                                  "attributes": [{"attribute": attr}], "description": description or quality_code, "apparel_material_type": "Fabric",
                                  "apparel_fabric_gsm": gsm, "apparel_fabric_width_cm": width_cm})
            add_uom_rows(tpl, gsm, width_cm)
            tpl.flags.ignore_permissions = True
            tpl.insert()
        elif not frappe.db.get_value("Item", quality_code, "has_variants"):
            return quality_code   # a plain (non-variant) fabric item is used as it is
        args = {attr: colour}
        code = frappe.call("erpnext.controllers.item_variant.get_variant", template=quality_code, args=args)
        if not code:
            variant = frappe.call("erpnext.controllers.item_variant.create_variant", item=quality_code, args=args)
            variant.update({"has_batch_no": 1, "apparel_material_type": "Fabric", "apparel_fabric_gsm": gsm, "apparel_fabric_width_cm": width_cm})
            add_uom_rows(variant, gsm, width_cm)
            variant.flags.ignore_permissions = True
            variant.insert()
            code = variant.name
        return code


    def ensure_trim_item(item_code, description, trim_category, uom, customer, buyer_code, customer_provided):
        """A plain stock item per trim code. The buyer code goes on Item Customer Detail."""
        ensure_uom(uom)
        if frappe.db.exists("Item", item_code):
            return item_code
        item = frappe.get_doc({"doctype": "Item", "item_code": item_code, "item_name": description or item_code, "item_group": material_item_group(), "stock_uom": uom,
                               "is_stock_item": 1, "is_purchase_item": 0 if customer_provided else 1, "is_sales_item": 0,
                               "is_customer_provided_item": 1 if customer_provided else 0, "customer": customer if customer_provided else None,
                               "description": description or item_code, "apparel_material_type": "Trim", "apparel_trim_category": trim_category})
        if customer and buyer_code:
            item.append("customer_items", {"customer_name": customer, "ref_code": buyer_code})
        item.flags.ignore_permissions = True
        item.insert()
        return item.name
    cint = frappe.utils.cint
    sc = frappe.get_doc("Sales Contract", frappe.form_dict.get("source_name"))
    sc.check_permission("read")
    if sc.docstatus != 1:
        frappe.throw("Submit (sign) the contract first.")
    if sc.sales_order and frappe.db.get_value("Sales Order", sc.sales_order, "docstatus") != 2:
        frappe.throw("Sales Order %s already exists for this contract." % sc.sales_order)
    colour_attr = frappe.db.get_single_value("Apparel Settings", "colour_attribute") or "Colour"
    size_attr = frappe.db.get_single_value("Apparel Settings", "size_attribute") or "Size"

    def line_of(size_row):
        cands = []
        for it in sc.items:
            if it.style_item == size_row.style_item and (it.colour or "").strip().upper() == (size_row.colour or "").strip().upper():
                if not size_row.buyer_po_no or (it.buyer_po_code or "").strip().upper() == size_row.buyer_po_no.strip().upper():
                    cands.append(it)
        if len(cands) != 1:
            frappe.throw("Size row %s: cannot tell which contract line it belongs to. Enter the buyer PO on it." % size_row.idx)
        return cands[0]

    warehouse = None
    for wh in (frappe.db.get_single_value("Apparel Settings", "fg_warehouse"), frappe.db.get_single_value("Stock Settings", "default_warehouse")):
        if wh and frappe.db.get_value("Warehouse", wh, "company") == sc.company:
            warehouse = wh
            break
    if not warehouse:
        frappe.throw("Set the Finished Goods warehouse in Apparel Settings (or the default warehouse in Stock Settings) before making a Sales Order.")
    first_delivery = None
    for it in sc.items:
        if it.ex_factory_date and (not first_delivery or frappe.utils.getdate(it.ex_factory_date) < frappe.utils.getdate(first_delivery)):
            first_delivery = it.ex_factory_date

    so = frappe.new_doc("Sales Order")
    so.update({"customer": sc.customer, "company": sc.company, "currency": sc.currency, "po_no": sc.buyer_po_no, "po_date": sc.contract_date,
               "transaction_date": sc.contract_date, "delivery_date": first_delivery, "incoterm": sc.incoterm, "named_place": sc.named_place,
               "payment_terms_template": sc.payment_terms_template, "tc_name": sc.terms_and_conditions, "terms": sc.terms,
               "apparel_sales_contract": sc.name, "set_warehouse": warehouse})
    rates = []
    for s in sc.sizes:
        if cint(s.qty) <= 0:
            continue    # a size nobody orders is not an order line (the ERP refuses a zero quantity)
        line = line_of(s)
        item_code = s.style_item
        if frappe.db.get_value("Item", s.style_item, "has_variants"):
            args = {colour_attr: canonical_attribute_value(colour_attr, s.colour), size_attr: canonical_attribute_value(size_attr, s.size)}
            item_code = frappe.call("erpnext.controllers.item_variant.get_variant", template=s.style_item, args=args)
            if not item_code:
                variant = frappe.call("erpnext.controllers.item_variant.create_variant", item=s.style_item, args=args)
                variant.insert()
                item_code = variant.name
            s.db_set("item_code", item_code)
        so.append("items", {"item_code": item_code, "qty": s.qty, "rate": line.rate, "uom": line.uom or "Nos", "delivery_date": line.ex_factory_date, "warehouse": warehouse,
                            "apparel_colour": s.colour, "apparel_size": s.size, "apparel_ship_to": s.ship_to, "apparel_buyer_po": s.buyer_po_no or line.buyer_po_code,
                            "apparel_etd": line.etd, "apparel_in_warehouse_date": line.in_warehouse_date, "apparel_qty_tolerance_pct": line.tolerance_pct,
                            "apparel_cost_sheet": line.cost_sheet})
        rates.append(line.rate)
    if not so.items:
        frappe.throw("Every size row on this contract has a quantity of zero, so there is nothing to order. Enter the pieces first.")
    so.run_method("set_missing_values")
    n = 0
    for row in so.items:
        row.rate = rates[n]
        row.price_list_rate = 0
        n = n + 1
    so.run_method("calculate_taxes_and_totals")
    frappe.flags.arinox_result = so.as_dict()


main()

records.script:
# API arinox_tech_pack_merge_measurements: converts Tech Pack measurement rows saved in the OLD layout (one row per point per size, fields
# size / value / tolerance_plus / tolerance_minus) to the current layout (one row per point, one column per size xxs..xxl, one tolerance).
# Needed only on a site that once held the old Tech Pack Measurement doctype: the old columns stay in the table, the new ones start at 0, so
# every point shows once per size with all sizes at 0 and the "entered twice" rule blocks the Tech Pack. A site that never had the old layout
# has no old columns and this returns converted = 0. Works on every Tech Pack, any customer. Safe to run again. Needs System Manager or
# Script Manager. Optional: tech_pack = one Tech Pack only.
def main():
    mine = frappe.get_all("Has Role", {"parent": frappe.session.user, "parenttype": "User"}, pluck="role")
    if frappe.session.user != "Administrator" and "System Manager" not in mine and "Script Manager" not in mine:
        frappe.throw("Only a System Manager or Script Manager can convert Tech Pack measurements.")

    standard = ["xxs", "xs", "s", "m", "l", "xl", "xxl"]
    # the sandbox has no has_column: read the column list with a plain select
    have = frappe.db.sql(
        "select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema = database() and table_name = 'tabTech Pack Measurement'", pluck=True)
    if "size" not in have or "value" not in have:
        frappe.flags.arinox_result = {"converted_points": 0, "removed_rows": 0, "left_alone": 0, "note": "no old-layout columns on this site; nothing to convert"}
        return
    plus = "tolerance_plus" if "tolerance_plus" in have else "0"
    minus = "tolerance_minus" if "tolerance_minus" in have else "0"

    only = frappe.form_dict.get("tech_pack")
    where = "parenttype = 'Tech Pack' and ifnull(size, '') != ''"
    args = []
    if only:
        where = where + " and parent = %s"
        args.append(only)
    rows = frappe.db.sql(
        "select name, parent, parentfield, idx, pom_code, point_of_measure, size, value, " + plus + " as tol_plus, " + minus + " as tol_minus "
        "from `tabTech Pack Measurement` where " + where + " order by parent, parentfield, idx",
        args, as_dict=True)

    # one group per point of measure inside a Tech Pack, in the order the points first appear
    groups = {}
    order = []
    for r in rows:
        key = "%s|%s|%s|%s" % (r.parent, r.parentfield, (r.pom_code or "").strip().upper(), (r.point_of_measure or "").strip().upper())
        if key not in groups:
            groups[key] = []
            order.append(key)
        groups[key].append(r)

    converted = 0
    removed = 0
    left_alone = 0     # a size that is not one of the seven columns (for example "14") cannot be stored in the new layout
    touched = []
    for key in order:
        members = groups[key]
        usable = [m for m in members if (m.size or "").strip().lower() in standard]
        left_alone = left_alone + len(members) - len(usable)
        if not usable:
            continue
        keeper = usable[0]
        values = {}
        tol = 0
        for m in usable:
            values[(m.size or "").strip().lower()] = m.value or 0
            tol = max(tol, m.tol_plus or 0, m.tol_minus or 0)
        values["tolerance"] = tol
        values["size"] = None
        values["value"] = 0
        frappe.db.set_value("Tech Pack Measurement", keeper.name, values, update_modified=False)
        for m in usable[1:]:
            frappe.delete_doc("Tech Pack Measurement", m.name, force=1, ignore_permissions=True)
            removed = removed + 1
        converted = converted + 1
        mark = keeper.parent + "|" + keeper.parentfield
        if mark not in touched:
            touched.append(mark)

    # close the gaps in the row numbers
    for mark in touched:
        parent = mark.split("|")[0]
        field = mark.split("|")[1]
        names = frappe.get_all("Tech Pack Measurement", {"parent": parent, "parentfield": field}, pluck="name", order_by="idx asc, creation asc")
        n = 0
        for name in names:
            n = n + 1
            frappe.db.set_value("Tech Pack Measurement", name, "idx", n, update_modified=False)

    frappe.flags.arinox_result = {"converted_points": converted, "removed_rows": removed, "left_alone": left_alone}


main()

# API arinox_tech_pack_create_style_item: the style as an Item template with Colour and Size attributes, adding any of this Tech Pack's
# sizes and colours that the attribute lists do not have yet. Answers the Item name.
def main():
    tp = frappe.get_doc("Tech Pack", frappe.form_dict.get("tech_pack"))
    tp.check_permission("write")
    frappe.new_doc("Item").check_permission("create")
    if tp.style_item:
        frappe.flags.arinox_result = tp.style_item
        return

    colour_attr = frappe.db.get_single_value("Apparel Settings", "colour_attribute") or "Colour"
    size_attr = frappe.db.get_single_value("Apparel Settings", "size_attribute") or "Size"

    def ensure_attribute_values(attribute, values):
        if not frappe.db.exists("Item Attribute", attribute):
            frappe.get_doc({"doctype": "Item Attribute", "attribute_name": attribute, "item_attribute_values": []}).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        adoc = frappe.get_doc("Item Attribute", attribute)
        existing = [v.attribute_value.strip().upper() for v in adoc.item_attribute_values]
        abbrs = [v.abbr.upper() for v in adoc.item_attribute_values]
        added = False
        for value in values:
            value = (value or "").strip()
            if not value or value.upper() in existing:
                continue
            abbr = "".join([ch for ch in value.upper() if ch.isalnum()])[:10] or value[:10]
            base = abbr
            n = 1
            while abbr in abbrs:
                n = n + 1
                abbr = "%s%s" % (base[:8], n)
            adoc.append("item_attribute_values", {"attribute_value": value, "abbr": abbr})
            existing.append(value.upper())
            abbrs.append(abbr)
            added = True
        if added:
            adoc.flags.ignore_permissions = True
            adoc.save()

    ensure_attribute_values(size_attr, [s.size for s in tp.sizes])
    ensure_attribute_values(colour_attr, [c.colour for c in tp.colours])

    item_code = tp.style_no.strip()
    if frappe.db.exists("Item", item_code):
        frappe.throw("Item %s already exists. Link it in Style Item instead." % item_code)
    group = (frappe.db.get_value("Product Type", tp.product_type, "item_group") if tp.product_type else None) or frappe.db.get_single_value("Apparel Settings", "style_item_group")
    if not group:
        frappe.throw("Set an Item Group on Product Type %s or a Style Item Group in Apparel Settings." % tp.product_type)
    item = frappe.get_doc({"doctype": "Item", "item_code": item_code, "item_name": tp.style_name or item_code, "item_group": group, "stock_uom": "Nos",
                           "is_stock_item": 1, "is_sales_item": 1, "has_variants": 1, "variant_based_on": "Item Attribute",
                           "attributes": [{"attribute": colour_attr}, {"attribute": size_attr}], "image": tp.front_image,
                           "description": "%s %s (%s)" % (tp.style_no, tp.style_name or "", tp.customer_name or tp.customer)}).insert()
    tp.db_set("style_item", item.name)
    frappe.flags.arinox_result = item.name


main()

            row.rate = lines[n]["rate"]

            n = n + 1

        return q
    flt = frappe.utils.flt

    def milestone_state(not_applicable, actual_date, partial, planned_date, revised_date):
        """[status, delay_days, progress]. Late = the current target (revised, else planned) has passed and it is not done.
        Delay is measured against the baseline: days late if done late, days overdue if still open, days slipped if revised."""
        cint = frappe.utils.cint
        getdate = frappe.utils.getdate
        today = getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate())
        if cint(not_applicable):
            return ["Not Applicable", 0, 0]
        due = getdate(revised_date or planned_date) if (revised_date or planned_date) else None
        base = getdate(planned_date) if planned_date else None
        if actual_date:
            return ["Done", max(frappe.utils.date_diff(actual_date, base), 0) if base else 0, 100]
        if due and due < today:
            return ["Late", max(frappe.utils.date_diff(today, base), 0) if base else 0, 50 if cint(partial) else 0]
        delay = max(frappe.utils.date_diff(due, base), 0) if (revised_date and base and due) else 0
        return ["In Progress" if cint(partial) else "Not Started", delay, 50 if cint(partial) else 0]


    def order_state(milestones, plan_feasible, cancelled):
        """[status, critical_delay_days] of an order from its milestone dicts."""
        cint = frappe.utils.cint
        getdate = frappe.utils.getdate
        today = getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate())
        if cancelled:
            return ["Cancelled", 0]
        live = [m for m in milestones if not cint(m.get("not_applicable"))]
        if live and len([m for m in live if m.get("actual_date")]) == len(live):
            return ["Completed", 0]
        crit_late = [m for m in live if cint(m.get("is_critical")) and not m.get("actual_date") and (m.get("revised_date") or m.get("planned_date"))
                     and getdate(m.get("revised_date") or m.get("planned_date")) < today]
        delays = [max(frappe.utils.date_diff(m.get("actual_date") or today, m["planned_date"]), 0) for m in live
                  if cint(m.get("is_critical")) and m.get("planned_date") and (m.get("actual_date") or m in crit_late)]
        worst = max(delays) if delays else 0
        if crit_late:
            return ["Late", worst]
        other_late = [m for m in live if not m.get("actual_date") and (m.get("revised_date") or m.get("planned_date")) and getdate(m.get("revised_date") or m.get("planned_date")) < today]
        soon = [m for m in live if cint(m.get("is_critical")) and not m.get("actual_date") and (m.get("revised_date") or m.get("planned_date"))
                and 0 <= frappe.utils.date_diff(m.get("revised_date") or m.get("planned_date"), today) <= 3]
        if other_late or soon or not cint(plan_feasible):
            return ["At Risk", worst]
        return ["On Track", worst]

        if not frappe.db.exists("Order TNA", name):
            return
        t = frappe.db.get_value("Order TNA", name, ["status", "plan_feasible", "critical_delay_days"], as_dict=True)

        for m in ms:
            st = milestone_state(m.not_applicable, m.actual_date, m.partial, m.planned_date, m.revised_date)
            colour = COLOURS[st[0]]
            if m.status != st[0] or m.delay_days != st[1] or m.progress != st[2] or m.color != colour:
                frappe.db.set_value("TNA Milestone", m.name, {"status": st[0], "delay_days": st[1], "progress": st[2], "color": colour}, update_modified=False)
            m["status"] = st[0]
        if t.status == "Cancelled":
            return
        o = order_state(ms, t.plan_feasible, False)
        if o[0] != t.status or o[1] != t.critical_delay_days:
            frappe.db.set_value("Order TNA", name, {"status": o[0], "critical_delay_days": o[1]}, update_modified=False)
    getdate = frappe.utils.getdate
    cint = frappe.utils.cint
    tna = frappe.db.get_value("Order TNA", doc.order_tna, ["sales_order", "style_no", "colour", "factory", "baseline_locked", "customer", "status"], as_dict=True)
    if not tna:
        frappe.throw("Order T&A %s does not exist." % doc.order_tna)
    doc.sales_order = tna.sales_order
    doc.style_no = tna.style_no
    doc.colour = tna.colour
    doc.factory = tna.factory
    doc.customer = tna.customer
    mt = frappe.get_cached_doc("TNA Milestone Type", doc.milestone_type)
    doc.label = doc.label or mt.label
    doc.department = doc.department or mt.department
    if doc.planned_date and not doc.planned_start:
        doc.planned_start = doc.planned_date
    if doc.planned_start and doc.planned_date and getdate(doc.planned_start) > getdate(doc.planned_date):
        doc.planned_start = doc.planned_date
    if cint(tna.baseline_locked) and not doc.is_new() and doc.has_value_changed("planned_date") and not doc.flags.baseline_move:
        frappe.throw("The baseline is locked. Use the Revised Date (with a reason) to move this milestone.")
    if doc.revised_date and doc.planned_date and getdate(doc.revised_date) != getdate(doc.planned_date) and not (doc.revision_reason or "").strip() and not doc.actual_date:
        frappe.throw("Enter the reason for the revised date.")
    if doc.actual_date and getdate(doc.actual_date) > getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate()):
        frappe.throw("The actual date cannot be in the future.")
    st = milestone_state(doc.not_applicable, doc.actual_date, doc.partial, doc.planned_date, doc.revised_date)
    doc.status = st[0]
    doc.delay_days = st[1]
    doc.progress = st[2]
    doc.color = COLOURS[st[0]]


run(doc)

                     and getdate(m.get("revised_date") or m.get("planned_date")) < today]

        worst = max(delays) if delays else 0
        if crit_late:
            return ["Late", worst]
        other_late = [m for m in live if not m.get("actual_date") and (m.get("revised_date") or m.get("planned_date")) and getdate(m.get("revised_date") or m.get("planned_date")) < today]
        soon = [m for m in live if cint(m.get("is_critical")) and not m.get("actual_date") and (m.get("revised_date") or m.get("planned_date"))
                and 0 <= frappe.utils.date_diff(m.get("revised_date") or m.get("planned_date"), today) <= 3]
        if other_late or soon or not cint(plan_feasible):

    def refresh_order_tna(name):

        for m in ms:

            m["status"] = st[0]
        if t.status == "Cancelled":

        o = order_state(ms, t.plan_feasible, False)
        if o[0] != t.status or o[1] != t.critical_delay_days:
            frappe.db.set_value("Order TNA", name, {"status": o[0], "critical_delay_days": o[1]}, update_modified=False)
    start = frappe.form_dict.get("start")
    end = frappe.form_dict.get("end")
    flt_ = frappe.form_dict.get("filters")

                           fields=["name", "label", "style_no", "colour", "planned_start", "planned_date", "revised_date", "actual_date", "status", "color", "not_applicable"])
    out = []
    for r in rows:
        if frappe.utils.cint(r.not_applicable):

        date = r.actual_date or r.revised_date or r.planned_date
        out.append({"name": r.name, "title": ("%s %s: %s" % (r.style_no or "", r.colour or "", r.label)).strip(), "start": str(date), "end": str(date), "allDay": 1,
                    "color": r.color or COLOURS.get(r.status), "status": r.status})

records.script:
# API arinox_tna_apply_plan: write a plan computed by the Cortex Tower onto an Order TNA, in one call. `rows` is a list (or JSON) of
# {milestone_type, planned_start, planned_date, sequence, is_critical}. Missing milestones are made; on an unlocked plan the planned dates are set
# (a milestone that already has an actual date is left alone); on a locked plan the planned dates are never touched and each row's `revised_date`
# (with the one `reason`) is set where it differs. The order's feasibility fields are set from `plan_feasible`, `feasibility_note`, `critical_delay_days`.
def main():
    f = frappe.form_dict
    rows = f.get("rows")
    if isinstance(rows, str):
        rows = json.loads(rows)
    cint = frappe.utils.cint
    getdate = frappe.utils.getdate
    tna = frappe.get_doc("Order TNA", f.get("order_tna"))
    tna.check_permission("write")
    if tna.status == "Cancelled":
        frappe.throw("Order T&A %s is cancelled; its plan is closed." % tna.name)
    locked = cint(tna.baseline_locked)
    made = 0
    moved = 0
    revised = 0
    kept = 0
    for r in rows:
        name = frappe.db.get_value("TNA Milestone", {"order_tna": tna.name, "milestone_type": r.get("milestone_type")}, "name")
        if not name:
            if locked:
                kept = kept + 1
                continue
            ms = frappe.new_doc("TNA Milestone")
            ms.order_tna = tna.name
            ms.milestone_type = r.get("milestone_type")
            ms.planned_date = getdate(r.get("planned_date"))
            ms.planned_start = getdate(r.get("planned_start") or r.get("planned_date"))
            ms.sequence = cint(r.get("sequence"))
            ms.is_critical = cint(r.get("is_critical"))
            ms.flags.ignore_permissions = True
            ms.insert()
            made = made + 1
            continue
        ms = frappe.get_doc("TNA Milestone", name)
        if ms.actual_date:
            kept = kept + 1
            continue
        if locked:
            want = r.get("revised_date")
            if want and getdate(want) != getdate(ms.revised_date or ms.planned_date):
                ms.revised_date = getdate(want)
                ms.revision_reason = f.get("reason") or ms.revision_reason
                ms.flags.ignore_permissions = True
                ms.save()
                revised = revised + 1
            else:
                kept = kept + 1
            continue
        if getdate(r.get("planned_date")) != getdate(ms.planned_date) or (r.get("planned_start") and getdate(r.get("planned_start")) != getdate(ms.planned_start)):
            ms.planned_date = getdate(r.get("planned_date"))
            ms.planned_start = getdate(r.get("planned_start") or r.get("planned_date"))
            ms.flags.ignore_permissions = True
            ms.save()
            moved = moved + 1
        else:
            kept = kept + 1
    if f.get("plan_feasible") is not None:
        tna.db_set("plan_feasible", cint(f.get("plan_feasible")))
    if f.get("feasibility_note") is not None:
        tna.db_set("feasibility_note", (f.get("feasibility_note") or "")[:140])
    if f.get("critical_delay_days") is not None:
        tna.db_set("critical_delay_days", cint(f.get("critical_delay_days")))
    frappe.flags.arinox_result = {"order_tna": tna.name, "made": made, "moved": moved, "revised": revised, "kept": kept, "locked": locked}


main()

# API arinox_api_wip_board_data: one Order TNA per row and one milestone per column, for the WIP board built outside this app. Status is computed from today's date.
def main():
    # shared helpers from tna/status.py: the state of a milestone and of an order, computed from today's date and never trusted from a stored value
    COLOURS = {"Done": "#2f855a", "In Progress": "#2b6cb0", "Late": "#c53030", "Not Started": "#718096", "Not Applicable": "#cbd5e0"}


    def milestone_state(not_applicable, actual_date, partial, planned_date, revised_date):
        """[status, delay_days, progress]. Late = the current target (revised, else planned) has passed and it is not done.
        Delay is measured against the baseline: days late if done late, days overdue if still open, days slipped if revised."""
        cint = frappe.utils.cint
        getdate = frappe.utils.getdate
        today = getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate())
        if cint(not_applicable):
            return ["Not Applicable", 0, 0]
        due = getdate(revised_date or planned_date) if (revised_date or planned_date) else None
        base = getdate(planned_date) if planned_date else None
        if actual_date:
            return ["Done", max(frappe.utils.date_diff(actual_date, base), 0) if base else 0, 100]
        if due and due < today:
            return ["Late", max(frappe.utils.date_diff(today, base), 0) if base else 0, 50 if cint(partial) else 0]
        delay = max(frappe.utils.date_diff(due, base), 0) if (revised_date and base and due) else 0
        return ["In Progress" if cint(partial) else "Not Started", delay, 50 if cint(partial) else 0]


    def order_state(milestones, plan_feasible, cancelled):
        """[status, critical_delay_days] of an order from its milestone dicts."""
        cint = frappe.utils.cint
        getdate = frappe.utils.getdate
        today = getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate())
        if cancelled:
            return ["Cancelled", 0]
        live = [m for m in milestones if not cint(m.get("not_applicable"))]
        if live and len([m for m in live if m.get("actual_date")]) == len(live):
            return ["Completed", 0]
        crit_late = [m for m in live if cint(m.get("is_critical")) and not m.get("actual_date") and (m.get("revised_date") or m.get("planned_date"))
                     and getdate(m.get("revised_date") or m.get("planned_date")) < today]
        delays = [max(frappe.utils.date_diff(m.get("actual_date") or today, m["planned_date"]), 0) for m in live
                  if cint(m.get("is_critical")) and m.get("planned_date") and (m.get("actual_date") or m in crit_late)]
        worst = max(delays) if delays else 0
        if crit_late:
            return ["Late", worst]
        other_late = [m for m in live if not m.get("actual_date") and (m.get("revised_date") or m.get("planned_date")) and getdate(m.get("revised_date") or m.get("planned_date")) < today]
        soon = [m for m in live if cint(m.get("is_critical")) and not m.get("actual_date") and (m.get("revised_date") or m.get("planned_date"))
                and 0 <= frappe.utils.date_diff(m.get("revised_date") or m.get("planned_date"), today) <= 3]
        if other_late or soon or not cint(plan_feasible):
            return ["At Risk", worst]
        return ["On Track", worst]


    def refresh_order_tna(name):
        """Recompute and store every milestone's status and the order's status."""
        if not frappe.db.exists("Order TNA", name):
            return
        t = frappe.db.get_value("Order TNA", name, ["status", "plan_feasible", "critical_delay_days"], as_dict=True)
        ms = frappe.get_all("TNA Milestone", filters={"order_tna": name}, fields=["name", "not_applicable", "actual_date", "partial", "planned_date", "revised_date", "is_critical",
                                                                                  "status", "delay_days", "color", "progress"])
        for m in ms:
            st = milestone_state(m.not_applicable, m.actual_date, m.partial, m.planned_date, m.revised_date)
            colour = COLOURS[st[0]]
            if m.status != st[0] or m.delay_days != st[1] or m.progress != st[2] or m.color != colour:
                frappe.db.set_value("TNA Milestone", m.name, {"status": st[0], "delay_days": st[1], "progress": st[2], "color": colour}, update_modified=False)
            m["status"] = st[0]
        if t.status == "Cancelled":
            return
        o = order_state(ms, t.plan_feasible, False)
        if o[0] != t.status or o[1] != t.critical_delay_days:
            frappe.db.set_value("Order TNA", name, {"status": o[0], "critical_delay_days": o[1]}, update_modified=False)
    cint = frappe.utils.cint
    getdate = frappe.utils.getdate
    f = frappe.form_dict.get("filters")
    f = json.loads(f) if isinstance(f, str) and f else (f or {})
    today = getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate())

    def cell_class(m):
        if cint(m.get("not_applicable")):
            return "na"
        due = m.get("revised_date") or m.get("planned_date")
        if m.get("actual_date"):
            return "done_late" if m.get("planned_date") and getdate(m["actual_date"]) > getdate(m["planned_date"]) else "done"
        if due and getdate(due) < today:
            return "late"
        if due and frappe.utils.date_diff(due, today) <= 7:
            return "soon"
        return "future"

    cond = [["status", "!=", "Cancelled"]] if not f.get("include_cancelled") else []
    for k in ("customer", "merchant", "factory", "sales_order", "status"):
        if f.get(k):
            cond.append([k, "=", f[k]])
    if f.get("ex_factory_from"):
        cond.append(["ex_factory_date", ">=", f["ex_factory_from"]])
    if f.get("ex_factory_to"):
        cond.append(["ex_factory_date", "<=", f["ex_factory_to"]])
    limit = min(cint(frappe.form_dict.get("limit")) or 200, 200)
    orders = frappe.get_list("Order TNA", filters=cond, order_by="ex_factory_date asc, name asc", limit_start=cint(frappe.form_dict.get("start")), limit_page_length=limit,
                             fields=["name", "sales_order", "customer", "style_no", "colour", "order_qty", "merchant", "factory", "ex_factory_date", "pcd", "status",
                                     "critical_delay_days", "plan_feasible", "feasibility_note", "baseline_locked", "ship_tos"])
    total = len(frappe.get_list("Order TNA", filters=cond, pluck="name", limit_page_length=0))
    names = [o.name for o in orders]
    ms = frappe.get_all("TNA Milestone", filters={"order_tna": ["in", names or [""]]}, order_by="sequence asc", limit_page_length=0,
                        fields=["name", "order_tna", "milestone_type", "label", "sequence", "planned_start", "planned_date", "revised_date", "actual_date", "partial", "not_applicable",
                                "is_critical", "depends_on_tasks", "owner_user", "delay_reason_category", "source_doctype", "source_name"])
    by_order = {}
    types = {}
    for m in ms:
        st = milestone_state(m.not_applicable, m.actual_date, m.partial, m.planned_date, m.revised_date)
        m["status"] = st[0]
        m["delay_days"] = st[1]
        m["progress"] = st[2]
        m["color"] = COLOURS[st[0]]
        m["cell"] = cell_class(m)
        if m.order_tna not in by_order:
            by_order[m.order_tna] = {}
        by_order[m.order_tna][m.milestone_type] = m
        if m.milestone_type not in types:
            types[m.milestone_type] = [m.sequence, m.label]
    for o in orders:
        res = order_state([by_order.get(o.name)[k] for k in by_order.get(o.name)] if by_order.get(o.name) else [], o.plan_feasible, False)
        o["status_live"] = res[0]
        o["critical_delay_days"] = res[1]
    if cint(f.get("late_only")):
        orders = [o for o in orders if o.status_live in ("Late", "At Risk")]
    kept = [o.name for o in orders]
    frappe.flags.arinox_result = {"orders": orders, "total": total, "today": frappe.utils.nowdate(),
                                  "types": [{"code": c, "label": types[c][1]} for c in sorted(types, key=lambda c: types[c][0])],
                                  "milestones": {k: by_order[k] for k in by_order if k in kept}}


main()

# API arinox_purchase_order_make_purchase_orders: draft Purchase Orders from an approved FR / TR, one per supplier, for the Material Request rows not yet ordered.
# Buyer-supplied trims are skipped. Answers the PO names.
def main():
    requisition_type = frappe.form_dict.get("requisition_type")
    name = frappe.form_dict.get("name")
    dt = "Fabric Requisition" if requisition_type == "FR" else "Trim Requisition"
    req = frappe.get_doc(dt, name)
    req.check_permission("read")
    frappe.new_doc("Purchase Order").check_permission("create")
    if req.docstatus != 1:
        frappe.throw("Approve (submit) the requisition first.")
    groups = {}
    order = []
    for r in req.items:
        if not r.material_request_item or frappe.utils.cint(r.get("customer_provided")) or not r.supplier:
            continue
        if frappe.db.exists("Purchase Order Item", {"material_request_item": r.material_request_item, "docstatus": ["<", 2]}):
            continue
        if r.supplier not in groups:
            groups[r.supplier] = []
            order.append(r.supplier)
        groups[r.supplier].append(r)
    made = []
    for supplier in order:
        rows = groups[supplier]
        po = frappe.new_doc("Purchase Order")
        po.company = req.company
        po.supplier = supplier
        po.transaction_date = frappe.utils.nowdate()

Needs lib_mat.py (stamp_safe). def card_context(production_card): c = frappe.db.get_value("Production Card", production_card, ["sales_order", "sales_contract", "customer", "style_item", "company", "status", "docstatus", "line"], as_dict=True) return c or {} def require_open_card(production_card): card = card_context(production_card) if not card or card.docstatus != 1 or card.status in ("Superseded", "Cancelled", "Closed"): frappe.throw("Production card %s must be issued and open." % production_card) return card def settings_value(field, default): v = frappe.db.get_single_value("Apparel Settings", field) return default if v in (None, "") else v def stamp_card(card, code, date, source_doctype, source_name, colours, partial): """Stamp a T&A milestone for every colour of the card's order. Never raises: a T&A fault must not stop shipping.""" c = card_context(card) if not colours: colours = [] for r in frappe.get_all("Production Card Line", filters={"parent": card}, fields=["colour"]): if r.colour not in colours: colours.append(r.colour) colours = sorted(colours) for colour in colours: stamp_safe(c.sales_order, c.style_item, colour, code, date, source_doctype, source_name, partial, False) # shared helpers for the subcontract documents: working-day arithmetic, the vendor-damage penalty, over/short %, the roll-up of returns onto a challan, the value of a piece. # Needs lib_shipping.py; the working-day due date also needs lib_tna_plan.py (holiday_dates). def add_working_days(start, days, holidays): """Date `days` working days after `start` (the day of receipt is day 0). Sundays and `holidays` are skipped.""" d = frappe.utils.getdate(start) left = int(days) hol = holidays or [] while left > 0: d = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.add_days(d, 1)) if d.weekday() == 6 or d in hol: continue left = left - 1 return d def penalty(sent, reject_vendor, threshold_pct, unit_value, scope): """[reject %, penalised qty, amount] for vendor-damaged pieces. Applies only when the vendor-fault rate is ABOVE the threshold.""" if not float(sent or 0): return [None, 0, 0.0] rate = float(reject_vendor or 0) / float(sent) * 100.0 if rate <= float(threshold_pct): return [rate, 0, 0.0] if scope == "Excess Only": qty = max(0, int(reject_vendor) - int(frappe.utils.floor(float(sent) * float(threshold_pct) / 100.0 + 1e-9))) else: qty = int(reject_vendor) return [rate, qty, qty * float(unit_value or 0)] def refresh_returns(challan): """Recompute what came back against each challan row and the challan status from the submitted returns.""" doc = frappe.get_doc("Subcontract Challan", challan) back = {} for r in frappe.db.sql("select r.colour, r.size, sum(r.good_qty + r.reject_vendor_qty + r.reject_factory_qty) from `tabSubcontract Return Row` r " "join `tabSubcontract Return` p on p.name = r.parent where p.docstatus = 1 and p.challan = %s group by r.colour, r.size", (challan,)): back["%s|%s" % (r[0], r[1])] = r[2] or 0 total = 0 for r in doc.rows: k = "%s|%s" % (r.colour, r.size) take = min(r.qty, back.get(k, 0)) back[k] = back.get(k, 0) - take total = total + take frappe.db.set_value("Subcontract Challan Row", r.name, "returned_qty", take, update_modified=False) status = doc.status if status != "Short Closed": status = "Returned" if total >= doc.total_qty else ("Partly Returned" if total else "Open") frappe.db.set_value("Subcontract Challan", challan, {"returned_qty": total, "status": status}, update_modified=False) def unit_value_for_card(card, basis): """Value of one piece for the penalty: the Cost Sheet FOB price, the Sales Order rate, or nothing for a fixed basis.""" if basis == "Fixed Per Piece": return 0.0 c = card_context(card) rows = frappe.db.sql("select i.rate, i.apparel_cost_sheet from `tabSales Order Item` i where i.parent = %s and i.item_code in " "(select name from `tabItem` where variant_of = %s or name = %s) order by i.idx limit 1", (c.sales_order, c.style_item, c.style_item), as_dict=True) if not rows: return 0.0 if basis == "Cost Sheet FOB" and rows[0].apparel_cost_sheet: price = frappe.db.get_value("Cost Sheet", rows[0].apparel_cost_sheet, "approved_price") if price: return frappe.utils.flt(price) return frappe.utils.flt(rows[0].rate) flt = frappe.utils.flt cint = frappe.utils.cint ch = frappe.db.get_value("Subcontract Challan", doc.challan, ["docstatus", "production_card", "total_qty", "subcontract_process", "supplier", "purchase_order"], as_dict=True) if not ch or ch.docstatus != 1: frappe.throw("Challan %s must be settlement." % doc.challan) proc = frappe.db.get_value("Subcontract Process", ch.subcontract_process, ["damage_threshold_pct", "qty_tolerance_pct"], as_dict=True) tot = frappe.db.sql("select # API arinox_close_get_checklist: the commercial-close checklist of an order.
def main():
    # shared helper from shipping/close.py: the commercial-close checklist of an order, as [label, ok, detail] rows. Pure reading; nothing is changed.
    def checklist(sales_order):
        flt = frappe.utils.flt
        cint = frappe.utils.cint
        out = []
        cards = frappe.get_all("Production Card", filters={"sales_order": sales_order, "docstatus": 1, "status": ["not in", ["Superseded", "Cancelled"]]}, fields=["name", "status"])
        open_cards = [c.name for c in cards if c.status not in ("Shipped", "Closed")]
        out.append(["Production finished", bool(cards) and not open_cards, ", ".join(open_cards) or ("no production card" if not cards else "")])
        dn_names = [r[0] for r in frappe.db.sql("select distinct parent from `tabDelivery Note Item` where against_sales_order = %s and docstatus = 1", (sales_order,))] or [""]
        dns = frappe.get_all("Delivery Note", filters={"docstatus": 1, "name": ["in", dn_names]}, fields=["name", "status"])
        unbilled = []
        for dn in dns:
            shipment = frappe.db.get_value("Delivery Note", dn.name, "apparel_shipment")
            billed = frappe.db.exists("Sales Invoice Item", {"delivery_note": dn.name, "docstatus": 1}) or (shipment and frappe.db.exists("Sales Invoice", {"apparel_shipment": shipment, "docstatus": 1}))
            if not billed:
                unbilled.append(dn.name)
        out.append(["Everything shipped is invoiced", bool(dns) and not unbilled, ", ".join(unbilled) or ("nothing shipped" if not dns else "")])
        contract = frappe.db.get_value("Sales Order", sales_order, "apparel_sales_contract")
        filters = {"docstatus": 1, "is_internal_customer": 0, "is_return": 0}
        if contract:
            filters["apparel_sales_contract"] = contract
        else:
            filters["name"] = ["in", [r[0] for r in frappe.db.sql("select distinct parent from `tabSales Invoice Item` where sales_order = %s", (sales_order,))] or [""]]
        unpaid = [i.name for i in frappe.get_all("Sales Invoice", filters=filters, fields=["name", "outstanding_amount"]) if flt(i.outstanding_amount) > 0.005]
        out.append(["Customer invoices paid", not unpaid, ", ".join(unpaid)])
        claims = frappe.get_all("Buyer Claim", filters={"sales_contract": contract, "docstatus": ["<", 2], "status": ["in", ["Open", "Under Review"]]}, pluck="name") if contract else []
        out.append(["No claim open", not claims, ", ".join(claims)])
        waiting = []
        if contract and frappe.db.exists("Sales Contract", contract):
            v = frappe.db.get_value("Sales Contract", contract, ["quality_claim_days", "quantity_claim_days"])
            longest = max(cint(v[0]), cint(v[1]))
            for s in frappe.get_all("Shipment", filters={"apparel_contracts": ["like", "%" + contract + "%"], "docstatus": ["<", 2]}, fields=["name", "apparel_contracts", "apparel_arrival_date", "apparel_delivery_date"]):
                if contract not in (s.apparel_contracts or "").splitlines():
                    continue      # a longer contract number that merely contains this one
                arrival = s.apparel_arrival_date or s.apparel_delivery_date
                if not arrival or frappe.utils.date_diff(frappe.utils.nowdate(), arrival) <= longest:
                    waiting.append(s.name)
        out.append(["Claim windows over", not waiting, ", ".join(waiting)])
        return out
    frappe.get_doc("Sales Order", frappe.form_dict.get("sales_order")).check_permission("read")
    frappe.flags.arinox_result = [{"label": r[0], "ok": r[1], "detail": r[2]} for r in checklist(frappe.form_dict.get("sales_order"))]


main()
